metadata.title: The metric extension problem under positive and negative curvature conditions
metadata.abstract: We first prove that every smooth boundary metric on a compact manifold extends to a metric with any prescribed positive lower bound for Ricci curvature, whereas extensions under stronger positive \(k^{\mathrm{th}}\)-intermediate Ricci curvature conditions may fail due to local obstructions. For negative sectional curvature, we identify a global obstruction to extension. We then consider the class of compact manifolds defined by the existence of a metric with negative sectional curvature and boundary index at most one. On every manifold in this class, we prove that any smooth boundary metric extends to a metric with negative sectional curvature and strictly convex umbilical boundary. We further show that every such initial metric admits a complete asymptotically hyperbolic isometric extension with the same curvature condition and any prescribed conformal infinity. This class of manifolds is closed under boundary connected sums. As a geometric application of these extension results, every smooth metric on \(\mathbb S^n\) admits a strictly convex isometric embedding into \(\mathbb R^{n+1}\) equipped with a complete metric of negative sectional curvature. The proofs combine neck constructions with corner smoothing for upper curvature bounds.
metadata.comment: 42 pages, 1 figure. Results and proofs obtained without AI; AI used only for language polishing

analysis.workSummary: 文章研究边界度量在正 Ricci 与负截面曲率条件下的延拓，辨认更强正曲率条件的局部障碍及负曲率延拓的整体障碍，并在特定流形类中给出带严格凸脐边界的负曲率延拓。
techniques: 上曲率界下的角点磨光
analysis.breakthrough: 在适用类别内还能指定共形无穷远，并得到球面度量在配备负曲率度量的欧氏拓扑空间中的凸等距嵌入。
analysis.limitations: 流形类别及边界指数条件必须保留；环境空间并非标准欧氏度量。 本条依据官方摘要与评论整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立核查记录为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露初稿完成后仅用 AI 润色语言，并声明数学思想、论证和结果由作者独立发展。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.21518v1 · PDF 第 8 页 Development of the results and AI usage statement

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露初稿完成后仅用 AI 润色语言，并声明数学思想、论证和结果由作者独立发展。

analysis.priorityReason: 统一多种曲率延拓与嵌入问题，几何构造方法值得优先读。
